d: Just like THIS! ✨ Finishing my ROV Pilot Technician competency = Dropping the “trainee” title!! 🦾 This trip has been tough. 😅😮‍💨 Out in the heat and humidity. Chasing unusual faults around the ROV. Exposed to so many different issues and scenarios. We ended up getting into parts of the system that people here said they hardly ever need to touch, yet this trip we were in and out of them repeatedly. 🙈 (20-year-old systems, anybody?) As long as the days were, and as steep as the learning curve felt, I wouldn’t have been able to complete my training portfolio without it. I’m incredibly grateful for everything I’ve learnt. The boss says, “Now the real work starts,” as the expectations are higher and there’s much more independence. I’m documenting this like I have every milestone in my career. I’m proud of myself for stepping off the navigational bridge and into the unknown. From submersibles, to AUVs, and now as an ROV Pilot Technician I (R03), I’ve finally achieved the goal I first set for myself back in 2021. Coming from a non-technical background and having to kick HARD just to keep my head above water, it hasn’t been without its challenges. A lot of self-study, plenty of extra reading, and, in the words of my supervisor… “a billion questions.” 😅 Although this is the finish line for one journey, it’s really only the start of a much bigger one. So let this be a reminder that if you really want something, don’t let yourself become the reason you never go after it. “Every version of you that you’ve ever wanted lies just beyond your comfort zone.” #rov #womenoffshore #subsea #offshorelife #careerprogression

Legend says it’s the soul of someone whose burial shroud was never released… trapped, wrapped, and restless. They’re said to hop, not walk — bound by the cloth — appearing pale, bruised, and silent. If you ever hear knocking at night or see one watching from a distance… run. 👻 This clip is going viral right now, and honestly, the movement in the background gave me chills. Real or staged? d: Apa yang dilakukan ketika bertemu @poci di jalan ❔ Jika seseorang tiba‐tiba berpapasan dengan pocong di jalan, terutama pada malam yang sunyi, dipercaya ia tidak boleh lari terburu‐buru. Dalam kepercayaan mistis Jawa, pocong dianggap sebagai roh yang terikat tali kafan karena belum “diantar pulang” sepenuhnya. Ia ingin menunjukkan keberadaannya, bukan sekadar menakuti. Diam sejenak, menundukkan kepala, dan mengucap salam atau doa singkat dipercaya sebagai cara memberi penghormatan kepada roh yang tersesat itu, agar tidak merasa terganggu oleh ketakutan manusia. Konon, jika seseorang langsung berlari tanpa menahan rasa paniknya, roh pocong akan merasa “diikuti” getaran takut itu dan menempel pada tubuh manusia, membuatnya mengalami mimpi buruk atau rasa berat di bagian tertentu ketika bangun tidur. Jika setelah menunduk dan memberi salam, pocong tidak bergerak, cukup mundur perlahan tanpa membelakangi, karena menurut mitos, membelakangi roh berarti membuka punggung untuk “ditunggui”. Barulah setelah jaraknya aman, orang tersebut boleh berbalik dan pergi dengan tenang, sambil berdoa agar roh itu menemukan jalan kembali ke alamnya. .  .  . zh: 路上遇到Pocong该怎么办？如果有人在路上突然撞见Pocong，尤其是在寂静的夜晚，据说不能慌张逃跑。在爪哇神秘信仰中，Pocong被认为是因尚未被完全“送回家”而被裹尸布捆绑的灵魂。它想表明自己的存在，而非仅仅吓人。稍停片刻，低头，致意或默念短祷文，被认为是向迷失的灵魂表示尊重，以免它被人类的恐惧不安所扰。据说，如果人不克制恐慌直接逃跑，Pocong的灵魂会感受到“跟随”而来的恐惧震动，并附着在人体上，导致做噩梦或醒来时身体某部位感到沉重。如果低头致意后Pocong未动，只需慢慢后退，不要背对它，因为根据神话，背对灵魂意味着敞开后背让它“守候”。等拉开安全距离后，方可转身平静离去，同时祈祷灵魂能找到回归其世界的路。有人经历过吗？

d: Misteri hilangnya Mozza Axillia Gunarsa (17), remaja asal Desa Gebugan, Kecamatan Bergas, Kabupaten Semarang, akhirnya terkuak setelah lebih dari satu tahun. Hilang sejak 25 Juni 2025, Mozza ditemukan tinggal kerangka di semak-belukar dekat Tol Jangli, Kecamatan Tembalang, Kota Semarang, pada Jumat (4/9/2026). Aksi keji ini didalangi oleh kekasihnya sendiri, MVDA (22). Remaja asal Blora ini mengaku cemburu hingga tega menghabisi nyawa korban. Petaka bermula pada Rabu pagi, 25 Juni 2025. Mozza berpamitan kepada orang tuanya untuk keluar rumah. Namun, ia justru menuju tempat kos pelaku di kawasan Tegalsari, Candisari, Kota Semarang. Di lokasi ini, terjadi cekcok setelah pelaku mendapati percakapan pesan antara korban dan pria lain di media sosial. Pelaku kemudian membekap korban dengan tangan kosong selama kurang lebih tujuh menit hingga tewas karena kehabisan oksigen. Guna menutupi jejak, pelaku sempat keluar untuk mengintai tempat pembuangan. Ia kembali ke kos, melipat tubuh korban dalam posisi meringkuk, mengikatnya dengan kabel ties serta tali rafia, lalu membungkusnya rapat menggunakan sarung, kardus, dan karung. Sekitar pukul 18.30 WIB, jasad korban diangkut menggunakan sepeda motor milik Mozza sendiri menuju tebing curam Tol Jangli untuk dibuang. Pelaku juga sempat mengirimkan pesan rekayasa dari ponsel korban ke rekannya yang mengaku hendak pergi ke Yogyakarta demi mengelabui keluarga. Selama lebih dari setahun, pihak keluarga bersama Kepolisian tak berhenti melakukan pencarian. Titik terang muncul saat tim Satreskrim membedah rekam jejak digital dan komunikasi elektronik milik korban. Petunjuk kuat mengarah pada sosok MVDA sebagai orang terakhir yang berinteraksi dengan Mozza. MVDA kemudian ditangkap sedang menonton pertandingan bola voli di Desa Kalitengah, Banjarejo, Kabupaten Blora pada Kamis malam (3/9/2026). Dari keterangan pelaku, polisi langsung bergerak mengevakuasi sisa kerangka korban di jurang Tol Jangli pada Jumat (4/9/2026). Kini, tersangka MVDA telah ditahan di Mapolrestabes Semarang dan dijerat Pasal Perlindungan Anak serta pasal pembunuhan dalam KUHP dengan ancaman hukuman maksimal 15 tahun penjara. (*/mon)
zh: 来自三宝垄县 Bergas 镇 Gebugan 村的 17 岁少女 Mozza Axillia Gunarsa 失踪之谜在一年多后终于揭晓。自 2025 年 6 月 25 日失踪后，Mozza 的骸骨于周五（2026 年 9 月 4 日）在三宝垄市 Tembalang 镇 Jangli 收费站附近的灌木丛中被发现。这起残忍罪行的主谋是其男友 MVDA（22 岁）。这名来自 Blora 的少年承认因嫉妒而忍心杀害受害者。惨剧始于 2025 年 6 月 25 日周三早晨。Mozza 向父母告辞出门，却前往了嫌疑人在三宝垄市 Candisari 区 Tegalsari 地区的住所。在该地，嫌疑人发现受害者与另一名男子在社交媒体上的聊天记录后发生争吵。嫌疑人随后徒手捂住受害者约七分钟，致其窒息死亡。为掩盖罪行，嫌疑人曾外出踩点抛尸地点。他回到住所，将受害者尸体折叠成蜷缩状，用扎带和塑料绳捆绑，然后用布、纸箱和麻袋将其包裹严实。约 18 时 30 分，嫌疑人用 Mozza 自己的摩托车将尸体运至 Jangli 收费站的陡峭悬崖丢弃。嫌疑人还用受害者手机向其朋友发送编造信息，声称要去日惹，以欺骗其家人。一年多来，家人与警方持续搜寻。转机出现在刑事调查组深入分析受害者的数字痕迹和电子通讯时。有力线索指向 MVDA 是最后与 Mozza 有交集的人。MVDA 随后于周四晚（2026 年 9 月 3 日）在 Blora 县 Banjarejo 区 Kalitengah 村观看排球赛时被捕。根据嫌疑人供述，警方于周五（2026 年 9 月 4 日）在 Jangli 收费站峡谷中移走了受害者遗骸。目前，嫌疑人 MVDA 已被关押在三宝垄市警察局拘留所，被控违反儿童保护法和刑法中的谋杀条款，面临最高 15 年监禁。

But is this mysterious footage genuine evidence of something unknown—or simply an elaborate hoax, special effect, costume, CGI, or cleverly staged video? Some regional traditions describe weredog-like creatures, while the Gabunan is described in Western Visayan folklore as an Aswang that takes the form of a huge bat. Jadi, dibotakin boleh, tidak dibotakin juga tidak masalah. Yang penting, rambut dan kulit kepala si kecil tetap dirawat dengan baik. 😊 💾 Save postingan ini untuk diingat dan 🔁 share ke Ayah Bunda lainnya yang sedang merawat bayi. #RambutBayi #HairLotionBayi #HairLotionSoymilk #faseemasrambut

d: POV: The baby is delivered… but still inside a clear, fluid-filled bubble. 👶✨ That’s not a complication. That’s a rare and beautiful moment. This is called an en caul birth 🌊 The newborn emerges completely enclosed within the intact amniotic sac — like a tiny water balloon cradling new life. What happens next? 👇 🩺 The medical team carefully opens the membrane 💧 Amniotic fluid drains 🫁 Air reaches the lungs 👶 First breath. First cry. It looks dramatic — but it’s a natural obstetric variation. High-yield facts 📚 • Extremely rare (more common in preterm births) • Usually seen in cesarean deliveries • The sac protects the baby during birth • Requires swift but gentle membrane rupture after delivery Exam pearl 💡 En caul ≠ complication. It’s simply delivery with intact membranes. zh: 宝宝已娩出，但仍包裹在透明充满羊水的囊中，这不是并发症，而是罕见又美丽的瞬间，称为胎膜完整分娩，新生儿完全包裹在完整的羊膜囊内，像一颗小小的水球守护着新生命，医疗团队会小心打开胎膜，羊水流出，空气进入肺部，迎来第一声啼哭，虽然看着惊心，但这是自然分娩的变体，极为罕见，多见于剖宫产，羊膜囊在分娩中保护宝宝，产后需快速轻柔破膜，胎膜完整分娩不等于并发症，只是完整胎膜下的分娩，很多医护人员职业生涯仅见一次，如果喜欢罕见产科瞬间请保存，对那些为分娩科学着迷的人可转发标记

d: You’ve Never Seen Dance Moves Like This The Dero dance is a high-energy routine known for its wild, unpredictable movements and nonstop flow. At first glance it looks chaotic, but a closer look reveals rhythm, timing, and impressive control. Dancers groove with their whole body, following the beat in a way that feels both messy and skillful. In some communities, this style has been practiced for decades, keeping the tradition alive through festivals, gatherings, and friendly competitions. It’s a unique combination of fun, endurance, and cultural identity that continues to stand out today.  #derodance #indonesia #tradition #interesting #interestingfacts #knowledge

d: Video latihan tari di Sanggar Pradnya Swari, Jembrana, Bali, viral di media sosial. Anak-anak yang berlatih—baik laki-laki maupun perempuan—tampak serius menguasai nyeledet, gerak mata khas dalam tari Bali. Nyeledet bukan sekadar melirik, tetapi gerakan cepat dan tajam yang harus selaras dengan ekspresi wajah, posisi kepala, dan irama gamelan. Teknik ini dikenal sulit karena membutuhkan konsentrasi tinggi serta kontrol otot mata yang kuat. Merujuk kajian seniman dan akademisi tari Bali, I Wayan Dibia, nyeledet menjadi elemen penting dalam membangun karakter tarian seperti Legong dan Kebyar, sekaligus menunjukkan kedalaman ekspresi penari. d: Pernah nggak sih, pengen masakan rumahan yang sederhana tapi rasanya “wah”? 💯 Hari ini aku masak Ayam Acar Kuning… dan jujur, ini tipe lauk yang bikin nasi di rumah cepat habis. 🔥🍀 Rasanya? Gurih, sedikit asam, ada pedasnya juga. Balance banget. Ini bukan cuma masakan… tapi comfort food yang selalu bikin kangen rumah. 🏡 RESEP AYAM ACAR KUNING - By Rudy Choirudin 🍀 Bahan 1: • 500 Gr Ayam • 1/2 Saset Bumbu Desaku Marinasi • 1 Saset Desaku bawang putih bubuk • 1/2 SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 2 SDM Tepung Maizena • 2 SDM Air Bahan 2: (blender/haluskan) • 8 buah Bawang Merah • 3 butir Kemiri Goreng • 3 Cm Jahe • 1 SDT Desaku kunyit bubuk • 1/2 SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 1 SDT Garam • 3 SDM Air Bahan 3: • 4 SDM Minyak Goreng (untuk menumis) • 1 batang Serai • 2 lembar Daun Salam • 150 ml Air • 1 SDM Gula • 1 saset Desaku bawang putih bubuk Bahan 4: • 8 buah Cabe Rawit • 50 Gr Wortel (potong batang korek lebih tebal) • 50 Gr Timun (potong batang korek lebih tebal) • 1 SDT Cuka Cara Memasak: 1. Campur semua Bahan 1 ke dalam kontainer, kocok rata kemudian diamkan 30 menit. 2. Goreng Ayam sampai kuning keemasan, tiriskan. 3. Blender Bahan 2, sampai halus. 4. Panaskan Minyak, masukkan bumbu yang sudah dihaluskan (Bahan 2). Tumis sampai harum dan matang. 5. Tambahkan Serai dan Daun Salam, tumis sampai mengeluarkan aroma. 6. Masukkan 150 ml Air, aduk merata hingga kuah mulai mengental. 7. Tambahkan Gula dan Desaku bawang putih bubuk, aduk rata. 8. Masukkan cabe rawit dan wortel, tambahkan timun dan cuka, aduk sesaat. 9. Masukkan ayam goreng, masak sampai bumbu meresap dan ayam terlumuri bumbu. 10. Angkat dan hidangkan. 🎬 Resep dan Video lengkap tersedia di YOUTUBE & FACEBOOK saya : @ResepSatset_Rudy dan @BukuResepSatsetRudy #masakanrumahan #resepviral #fypindonesia #menuharian #masaksimple

d: Resepi Ikan Tenggiri Masak Asam Jangan lupa save. Bahan-bahan * 1 ekor ikan tenggiri (dipotong) * Serbuk kunyit secukupnya * Garam secukupnya * Minyak untuk menggoreng Bahan tumis * 5 biji bawang merah kecil (dibiarkan sebiji) * 3 ulas bawang putih (dihiris) * 1 tangkai cili besar hijau (dipotong kasar) * 2 tangkai cili padi merah (dipotong kasar) Bahan kuah * 1 cawan air asam jawa * Air secukupnya untuk kuah * 2 biji tomato (dipotong) * Sos tiram secukupnya * Garam secukup rasa * Serbuk perasa secukup rasa * Sedikit gula Cara Memasak 1. Gaulkan ikan tenggiri bersama serbuk kunyit dan garam, kemudian goreng hingga garing. Angkat dan ketepikan. 2. Panaskan sedikit minyak, kemudian tumis bahan tumis hingga naik bau dan sedikit layu. 3. Masukkan air secukupnya bersama 1 cawan air asam jawa. Biarkan kuah mendidih. 4. Masukkan sos tiram, garam, serbuk perasa dan sedikit gula. Kacau hingga sebati dan sesuaikan rasa. 5. Masukkan ikan tenggiri yang telah digoreng, kemudian biarkan kuah mereneh seketika supaya rasa lebih meresap. 6. Masukkan tomato dan masak sekejap hingga tomato sedikit lembut. 7. Tutup api dan sedia untuk dihidangkan bersama nasi panas. Tip: Jangan gaul terlalu kuat selepas masukkan ikan supaya isi tak mudah hancur. Kalau suka kuah lebih pekat, biarkan mereneh sekejap sebelum tutup api. Selamat Mencuba 😋 #resepi #ikantenggiri #masakdirumah

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.
zh: 印尼炒饭 食材：蒜末3瓣，鸡蛋1个，熟米饭3杯，鱼饼薄片4片，大虾4只去壳去虾线，鲜鱿鱼适量洗净切片，生抽1汤匙，甜酱油2汤匙，黑焦糖酱1茶匙，参巴酱1汤匙，YumYum或味精一大撮，鸟眼辣椒1个切细片，小葱1根切薄片，炸蒜2汤匙，黄瓜片和番茄片佐餐，煎蛋佐餐。 步骤：1. 大火烧热炒锅，加少许油。放入蒜末炒香。 2. 打入鸡蛋快速炒散，炒成小块。 3. 加入米饭，彻底翻炒，打散结块，确保米饭均匀裹上蛋液和蒜末。 4. 加入鱼饼、虾和鱿鱼。翻炒均匀至海鲜熟透。 5. 加入生抽、甜酱油、黑焦糖酱和参巴酱。充分翻炒，使酱汁均匀包裹米饭和食材。 6. 加入鸟眼辣椒和葱花。快速翻炒均匀。 7. 撒上炸蒜，最后再翻炒一次。 8. 趁热享用，佐以黄瓜片和番茄片，顶部放一个煎蛋。

d: Martabak Manis: Cheesy and chocolatey Indonesian street pancake! RECIPE⬇️⬇️ Translated from DapurHasika on YouTube. Check her out for a video guide INGREDIENTS: 340 g all purpose flour 6 tbsp granulated sugar, or to taste 1/2 tsp salt 460 ml water 2 eggs 1/4 tsp vanilla extract  1 tsp baking soda 1 tsp baking powder Cheese, condensed milk, chocolate sprinkles, or any topping you like! A VERY nonstick pan METHOD: -in a bowl, mix the flour, sugar, and salt, until combined.  -Add water, and using an electric mixer (or a whisk), beat until combined into a thick but liquidy batter. Lumps are fine.  -Add the eggs, and beat. You want to strengthen the gluten and incorporate air, so beat for at least 5 minutes, I did 7 minutes with my mixer but more like 10 minutes with a whisk.  -It should now be completely smooth and increased in size -Whisk in vanilla, the baking soda, and powder. Beat again for 30 seconds and scrape the sides of the bowl to ensure it’s evenly distributed  -Get a VERY nonstick pan, rub a small amount of oil on the pan and wipe with a dry paper towel, to create an invisible film of oil -You can divide your batter into 3 even parts for an 8 inch. nonstick, or two parts for a 9-10 inch. Thinner pancake will not have a honeycomb.  -Heat over high heat. Splash some water on the pan. If it bounces and rolls on the surface, it’s ready for the batter. If it sputters and boils instantly, it’s not hot enough.  -pour the measured batter into the pan. Immediately rotate the pan to thinly coat the sides, about 1cm above the batter. -Return to the flame and turn the heat to medium.  -After about 1-2 minutes you should see many wet bubbles appearing on the top. At this point, you can choose to GENTLY sprinkle some sugar on the top, not too much as it can weight down the wet batter, and cover with a lid. Sugar is definitely not necessary. Then turn the heat to medium low.  -Throughout the process, monitor your pancake by smell and by looking at the thin layer to gauge what the bottom looks like. You can gently peek at the bottom of the pancake to see if it’s burning. After about 5-6 minutes, if the top looks dry, it’s ready.  -Carefully remove form the pan and add toppings -Enjoy! Tips:  Don’t be discouraged if the first pancake doesn’t work out. Use it as an opportunity to see what is going wrong. The heat needs to be hot at the beginning to encourage the formation of the honeycomb and the dry and crunchy crust. I think you want to have the heat as high as you can without burning the pancake for this recipe—cooking low and slow prevents the dramatic honeycomb. Similarly, the timing for making these will be different for everyone’s stove and pan size. So go by appearance and smell to see if it’s ready. #martabakmanis #dessert #indonesia #internationalfood
zh: 印尼甜味煎饼：芝士巧克力风味的印尼街头煎饼！食谱如下 转自YouTube博主DapurHasika，可观看她的视频教程。 食材：中筋面粉340克，白砂糖6汤匙，盐半茶匙，水460毫升，鸡蛋2个，香草精四分之一茶匙，小苏打1茶匙，泡打粉1茶匙，芝士、炼乳、巧克力碎或任何你喜欢的配料！一个非常不粘的锅。 做法：-在大碗中混合面粉、糖和盐，搅拌均匀。-加水，用电动打蛋器或手动打蛋器搅打至顺滑但仍有流动性的面糊。有小颗粒没关系。-加入鸡蛋，继续搅打。为了加强面筋并打入空气，至少搅打5分钟，我用电动打蛋器打了7分钟，手动打蛋器则需10分钟左右。-搅打至面糊完全顺滑且体积增大。-加入香草精、小苏打和泡打粉，再搅打30秒，刮下碗边的面糊以确保均匀。-准备一个非常不粘的锅，用极少量的油涂抹锅面，再用厨房纸巾擦干，形成一层看不见的油膜。-若用8英寸不粘锅，可将面糊分成3等份；若用9-10英寸锅，则分成2等份。较薄的煎饼不会产生蜂窝状结构。-大火加热锅子。在锅面洒几滴水，如果水珠能在锅面弹跳滚动，表示温度适宜倒入面糊。如果水珠噼啪作响并迅速沸腾，则温度还不够。-将量好的面糊倒入锅中。立即转动锅子，让面糊薄薄地挂在锅壁上，约高出面糊1厘米。-将锅

d: 🍗 Ayam tuh potensinya banyak! Jangan digoreng terussss ❌🙅‍♂️ Jangan sampe potensi ayam sia-sia! Sekali-sekali, coba deh kalo punya ayam dibikin jadi ayam palekko khas Bugis gini.. Pedas, gurih, medoknya pasti sukses ngabisin beras 3 karung 😅🤣 emang deh, masakan Indonesia ga ada matinya! AYAM PALEKKO Bahan 1: • 500 Gr Ayam (potong 20 bagian) • 1 SDT Desaku kunyit bubuk • 1 ½ SDT Garam • 1 SDM Air Bahan 2: (blender/haluskan) • 6 Buah Bawang Merah • 3 Buah Kemiri (goreng) • 3 Cm Jahe • 3 Cm Lengkuas • 1 SDM Desaku cabe bubuk • 1 Batang Serai (ambil 10 cm bagian putihnya saja dan rajang • 3 SDM Air Bahan 3: • 5 SDM Minyak Goreng (untuk menumis) • 3 Lembar Daun Jeruk • 2 Lembar Daun Salam Bahan 4: • 250 ml Air • 2 Kelereng Asam Jawa (rendam dengan 3 sdm air panas, ambil airnya) • 2 SDT Desaku bawang putih bubuk • ½ SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 1 SDT Gula Cara Memasak: 1. Campurkan semua Bahan 1 ke dalam kontainer. Kocok hingga tercampur rata. Diamkan selama 30 menit. 2. Blender Bahan 2, sampai halus. 3. Panaskan 5 sendok makan Minyak, tumis bumbu yang sudah diblender (Bahan 2) sampai naik minyak. 4. Tambahkan Daun Jeruk dan Daun Salam, tumis sampai mengeluarkan aroma. 5. Masukkan ayam, tumis sampai ayam berubah warna. 6. Masukkan Bahan 4, masak sampai mendidih. 7. Kecilkan api dan masak selama 10 menit dengan wajan tertutup. 8. Lanjutkan memasak dengan wajan terbuka sampai mulai berminyak dan kekentalan kuah yang diinginkan 9. Angkat dan hidangkan. #makassar #masakanrumahan #indonesianfood
zh: 鸡肉潜力巨大！别再总炸着吃了。别浪费了鸡肉的潜能！偶尔试试看，如果你有鸡肉，就做成这种布吉斯风味的Palekko鸡吧。辛辣、咸香、浓郁，绝对能让你干掉3袋大米。印尼菜真是绝了！ PALLEKKO鸡 食材1：500克鸡肉（切20块）、1茶匙Desaku姜黄粉、1.5茶匙盐、1汤匙水。 食材2（搅打/研磨至细腻）：6个红葱头、3颗石栗（炸过）、3厘米生姜、3厘米南姜、1汤匙Desaku辣椒粉、1根香茅（取10厘米白色部分，切碎）、3汤匙水。 食材3：5汤匙食用油（用于煸炒）、3片青柠叶、2片月桂叶。 食材4：250毫升水、2颗酸角球（用3汤匙热水浸泡，取汁液）、2茶匙Desaku大蒜粉、半茶匙Ladaku白胡椒粉、1茶匙糖。 烹饪方法：1. 将食材1所有材料放入容器中混合，摇晃至均匀，腌制30分钟。2. 将食材2搅打至细腻。3. 加热5汤匙油，将搅打好的香料（食材2）炒至油分析出。4. 加入青柠叶和月桂叶，炒至出香。5. 放入鸡肉，翻炒至变色。6. 加入食材4，煮至沸腾。7. 调小火，盖上锅盖煮10分钟。8. 打开锅盖继续煮，直到开始出油、汤汁达到你想要的浓稠度。9. 出锅装盘。

d: Resep Ayam Goreng Padang (untuk 8 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 2 ekor ayam pejantan utuh 1 buah jeruk nipis bumbu halus Bahan bumbu halus: 6 siung bawang putih 2 sdt ketumbar 4 cm jahe, iris 4 cm kunyit, iris 8 cm lengkuas, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk, buang batang 2 sdt garam 2 sdt kaldu ayam bubuk ¼ sdt merica 1 sdt penyedap 75 gr kelapa parut 4 sdm tepung beras 2 butir telur Bahan sambal cabe ijo: 100 ml minyak 15 siung bawang merah 160 gr cabai hijau, potong 2 buah tomat hijau, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk 1 sdt garam 1 sdt penyedap Pelengkap: nasi putih timun, kupas jeruk nipis Cara membuat: 1. Untuk bumbu halus, siapkan blender dan masukkan bawang putih, ketumbar, jahe, kunyit, lengkuas, daun jeruk, garam, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, penyedap, kelapa parut, tepung beras dan telur, lalu haluskan 2. Potong ayam menjadi empat bagian dan buang kulitnya. Marinasi ayam dengan perasan jeruk nipis dan bumbu halus, aduk merata. Diamkan minimal 1 jam di suhu ruang atau semalaman di kulkas 3. Goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi di minyak panas dengan api sedang hingga matang kecokelatan, angkat dan tiriskan 4. Untuk tambahan serundeng, goreng sisa bumbu marinasi hingga kuning keemasan lalu angkat dan tiriskan 5. Untuk sambal cabe ijo, panaskan minyak sisa menggoreng ayam, lalu masukkan bawang merah dan cabai hijau yang sudah dipotong, tumis hingga layu. Siapkan food chopper dan masukkan tumisan bawang merah dan cabai hijau, lalu haluskan sesaat 6. Tumis tomat hijau dengan minyak sisa tumisan bawang dan cabai. Tambahkan daun jeruk dan bahan sambal yang sudah dihaluskan, tumis sesaat. Tambahkan garam dan penyedap, aduk rata 7. Ayam Goreng Padang siap disajikan
zh: 巴东炸鸡食谱（8人份）。腌料：2只整鸡、1个青柠。香料糊：6瓣大蒜、2茶匙香菜、4厘米生姜切片、4厘米姜黄切片、8厘米南姜切片、5片青柠叶去茎、2茶匙盐、2茶匙鸡粉、¼茶匙胡椒粉、1茶匙味精、75克椰丝、4汤匙米粉、2个鸡蛋。青辣椒酱材料：100毫升油、15个红葱头、160克青辣椒切段、2个青番茄切片、5片青柠叶、1茶匙盐、1茶匙味精。配菜：白米饭、黄瓜去皮、青柠。做法：1. 将所有香料糊材料放入搅拌机打碎。2. 鸡切四块去皮，用青柠汁和香料糊腌制，室温至少1小时或冰箱冷藏过夜。3. 中火油炸腌制好的鸡至熟透金黄，捞出沥油。4. 将剩余腌料炸至金黄作为椰丝配料。5. 用余油炒香红葱头和青辣椒至软，用食物切碎机稍打碎。6. 用余油炒青番茄，加入青柠叶和打好的辣椒酱，翻炒片刻，加盐和味精调味。7. 巴东炸鸡即可上桌

d: Resep Ayam Goreng Bawang Merah (untuk 3 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 300 gr paha ayam filet ½ sdm perasan jeruk limau ½ sdm kaldu ayam bubuk 1/8 sdt merica 1 sdt gula pasir 1 sdt bawang putih bubuk 2 sdt kecap ikan 4 sdm tepung tapioka 1 sdm air Bahan lainnya: 75 gr bawang merah 4 buah cabai rawit merah (opsional) 1 ½ sdt kaldu jamur 1 sdt gula pasir Bahan pelengkap: nasi putih timun Cara membuat: 1. Potong-potong ayam kemudian marinasi dengan perasan jeruk limau, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, gula pasir, bawang putih bubuk, kecap ikan dan tepung tapioka, aduk rata 2. Tambahkan air, aduk rata. Diamkan minimal selama 15 menit 3. Iris bawang merah dan cabai rawit merah. Panaskan minyak, goreng bawang merah iris hingga sedikit kecoklatan, tiriskan dan biarkan minyak di wajan 4. Dengan minyak yang sama, goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi hingga matang lalu sisihkan minyak 5. Masukkan bawang merah goreng, cabai rawit merah, kaldu jamur, dan gula pasir, aduk rata 6. zh: 红葱头炸鸡食谱（3人份）。腌料：300克鸡腿肉、½汤匙青柠汁、½汤匙鸡粉、⅛茶匙胡椒粉、1茶匙白糖、1茶匙蒜粉、2茶匙鱼露、4汤匙木薯粉、1汤匙水。其他材料：75克红葱头、4个红小米椒（可选）、1½茶匙蘑菇精、1茶匙白糖。配菜：白米饭、黄瓜。做法：1. 鸡肉切块，用青柠汁、鸡粉、胡椒粉、白糖、蒜粉、鱼露、木薯粉腌制均匀。2. 加水拌匀，静置至少15分钟。3. 红葱头和小米椒切片。热油将红葱头炸至微黄捞出，油留锅中。4. 用同一锅油炸熟腌好的鸡肉，盛出备用。5. 放入炸红葱头、小米椒、蘑菇精和白糖，翻炒均匀。6. 红葱头炸鸡即可上桌

Asem-Asem Kuah Kuning Ayam Bahan 1 * 500 Gr Ayam, potong sesuai selera * 1 Liter Air Bahan 2 (Bumbu Kuah Kuning) * ½ Sachet Desaku kunyit bubuk * 1 Sachet Desaku bawang putih bubuk * 15 Gr Asam Jawa Tanpa Biji * ½ sachet Ladaku merica bubuk * 1 SDT Gula Pasir * 2 SDT Garam * 2 SDM Air Hangat Bahan 3 * 5 Buah Bawang Merah (rajang) * 2 Cm Lengkuas, memarkan * 1 Batang Serai, memarkan * 2 Lembar Daun Salam Bahan 4 * 2 Buah Tomat Hijau, potong menjadi 4 bagian atau 5 buah belimbing wuluh * 1 Buah Tomat Merah, potong menjadi 4 bagian * 1 Buah Cabe Besar (iris serong) * 1 Genggam Daun Kemangi Cara Memasak 1. Lumuri AYAM  dengan bumbu marinasi sambil diaduk perlahan hingga seluruh permukaan ikan terlapisi bumbu. Diamkan selama 30 menit agar bumbu meresap. 4. Didihkan 1 liter air di dalam panci. 5. Masukkan Bawang merah rajang, lengkuas, serai, dan daun salam. Rebus selama 2 menit hingga aroma rempah keluar. 6. Masukkan ikan beserta seluruh bumbu marinasinya. Bilas wadah marinasi dengan sedikit air rebusan, lalu tuangkan ke dalam panci agar tidak ada bumbu yang terbuang. 7.  Masak dengan api sedang selama sekitar 10 menit kemudian Masukkan irisan Cabe besar, tomat hijau atau belimbing wuluh serta tomat merah. Masak lagi sekitar 10 menit lagi  atau hingga AYAM matang. 8. Matikan api, lalu masukkan daun kemangi. Aduk perlahan hingga daun kemangi layu oleh panas kuah. 9. Sajikan Asem-Asem Kuah Kuning AYAM selagi hangat #reseprumahan #menusimple #menudiet

Creamy cabbage pasta (serves 1) -1 small head of cabbage, sliced as seen in the video  -1/3 cup egg whites -1 egg  -1/4 cup Greek yogurt  -olive oil  -salt & pepper  -fresh shaved parm, for garnish  1. Preheat oven to 400° 2. Add sliced cabbage to a baking sheet with parchment paper and spray or drizzle with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and roast for 15-20 min.  3. Meanwhile, whisk egg & egg whites in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. 4. Add however much cabbage you want to a skillet over medium heat and add the egg mixture. Mix the eggs around with the cabbage until eggs are cooked.  5. Remove from heat and stir in the Greek yogurt.  6. Serve with freshly grated parm, salt & pepper  #cabbage #dinner #healthyfood #healthyeating #protein

CHICKEN KEBAB #food #recipe #chicken #kebab GROUND CHICKEN 50 g red bell pepper, finely diced 50 g green bell pepper, finely diced 15 g fresh parsley, finely chopped 100 g yellow onion (1 onion), finely chopped 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped 7 g salt (1⅙ tsp) 5 g ground cumin (1⅔ tsp) 5 g paprika (1⅔ tsp) 1 g chili flakes 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 2 g black pepper (⅔ tsp) lemon juice (½ lemon) 45 ml olive oil 750 g ground chicken WRAP wraps vegetables of your choice sauce of your choice Ready all the ingredients. Add the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, fresh parsley, yellow onion, and garlic to a food processor. Blend until you have a vegetable mixture. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large, deep bowl. Add the salt, ground cumin, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne pepper, black pepper, lemon juice, olive oil, and ground chicken. Knead until combined. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the chicken mixture evenly over the baking sheet and press it down firmly. Then cut the mixture into straight strips. Use a spoon to press half-moon shapes next to each other. Place the kebab in a preheated oven at 225°C (440°F). Bake for 20–25 minutes. Then switch the oven to the grill setting and grill for 5 minutes, or until the top is nicely golden brown and slightly crispy. Take a wrap and spread with your desired sauce. Fill the wrap with vegetables and pieces of kebab. Fold the wrap until closed. Grill the filled wrap until the wrap is nicely crispy and golden brown.

d: Cobain bikin roti kukus ala Abah Geboy Bahan-bahan: - ​Terigu: 250 gram (sekitar 12 sendok makan) - ​Telur: 2 butir - ​Ragi Instan: 1 sendok makan - ​Gula Pasir: 3 sendok makan - ​Susu Kental Manis: 1 sendok makan - ​Minyak Goreng: 2 sendok makan - ​Air + Perisa Pandan: 1/4 gelas - ​Isian: Cokelat meses secukupnya - ​Pelengkap: Garam & perisa vanila secukupnya ​👨‍🍳 Cara Membuat: - ​Campur Bahan Utama: Masukkan air pandan, telur, gula, terigu, ragi, perisa vanila, garam, dan susu kental manis ke dalam wadah. - ​Uleni: Aduk dan uleni adonan menggunakan tangan. Tambahkan minyak goreng, lalu uleni terus sampai adonan kalis. - ​Bagi & Isi: Bagi adonan menjadi 7 bagian. Isi bagian tengahnya dengan meses, lalu bentuk bulat dan susun rapi di dalam cetakan. - ​Istirahatkan Adonan (Proofing): Tutup cetakan dan diamkan adonan selama 1 jam sampai mengembang. - ​Kukus: Kukus selama 15 menit (jangan kekelamaan ya, supaya rotinya tidak terlalu kering). - ​Sajikan: Roti kukus pandan isi cokelat yang lembut siap dinikmati selagi hangat!
zh: 试试做Abah Geboy风格的蒸面包。材料：面粉250克，鸡蛋2个，即发酵母1汤匙，白砂糖3汤匙，炼乳1汤匙，食用油2汤匙，水+班兰香精1/4杯，馅料：巧克力碎适量，辅料：盐和香草香精适量。做法：将班兰水、鸡蛋、糖、面粉、酵母、香草香精、盐和炼乳放入容器中混合。用手揉面，加入食用油，继续揉至面团光滑不粘手。将面团分成7份，中间包入巧克力碎，整形成圆形，整齐摆入模具。盖上盖子，醒发1小时至面团膨胀。蒸15分钟（不要蒸太久，以免面包太干）。柔软班兰巧克力蒸面包，趁热享用！

d: Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. zh: 网络爆火的平底锅煎饺——底部酥脆，内馅惊人地鲜美多汁！如果你喜欢亚洲风味，一定要收藏这个食谱。用以下配料可做2大份。配料：20张虾饺皮，500克猪肉末，1根胡萝卜，一大把香葱，6瓣大蒜，1汤匙姜末，2汤匙酱油，2汤匙蚝油，1汤匙芝麻油，1茶匙蔗糖，1茶匙盐，125毫升蔬菜高汤。制作步骤：1.胡萝卜擦丝，香葱切碎，大蒜压成泥。2.将胡萝卜、香葱、大蒜和姜末加入猪肉末中。3.加入酱油、蚝油、芝麻油、蔗糖和盐，全部搅拌均匀。4.取适量馅料放在虾饺皮中央，仔细捏紧收口。5.将饺子摆入平底锅，中火煎约2分钟，至底部开始变金黄。6.倒入125毫升蔬菜高汤，盖上锅盖，煮约16分钟。7.打开锅盖，完成！淋上辣椒油或额外酱油味道最佳。每份营养价值：825大卡，62克蛋白质，39克脂肪，57克碳水化合物，4克纤维。底部酥脆，面皮柔软，馅料香气四溢又多汁。绝对是值得收藏的食谱之一！保存并转发给那个你想和他一起吃光整锅煎饺的人吧！

d: Gratin dauphinois  For anyone looking for the app, the link is in my bio or you can search "Osta Recipes" on the App Store or Google Play Store!  Ingredients: 1.5 kg potatoes 400 g milk 500 g heavy cream 2 cloves garlic Thyme, bay leaf Salt, black pepper 30 g butter Preparation Method: 1/ Slice the potatoes and arrange them evenly in the baking dish. 2/ Mix the milk, cream, garlic, and butter in a pot, season with thyme, salt, and black pepper, then place over the heat. 3/ Pour the cream mixture over the potatoes, then cover the dish with parchment paper first, followed by aluminum foil. 4/ Place it in the oven at 200°C for 1h30min. 5/ Once cooked, top with shredded cheese and return it to the oven until melted, then take it out @Osta - Recipe Tracker  #food #cooking #gratin #gratinduphinois #recipe
zh: 法式奶油焗土豆。想找这个App的人，链接在我简介里，或可在App Store/Google Play商店搜索"Osta Recipes"。食材：土豆1.5公斤、牛奶400克、淡奶油500克、大蒜2瓣、百里香、月桂叶、盐、黑胡椒、黄油30克。做法：1/土豆切片，均匀铺在烤盘里。2/将牛奶、奶油、大蒜和黄油在锅中混合，用百里香、盐和黑胡椒调味，然后加热。3/将奶油混合物倒在土豆上，先用烘焙纸盖住，再用铝箔纸包好。4/放入200°C烤箱烤1小时30分钟。5/烤好后，撒上芝士碎再放回烤箱烤化，即可取出。@Osta - Recipe Tracker

d: Spicy short rib brothy rice bowl SOUPS THAT DON’T SUCK / episode 61 the ultimate comfort food! I don’t think i’ve stopped thinking about this bowl since I made. A couple years ago, I got to work with a Thai chef (Jam Sanitchat) who taught me her yellow curry, and I’ve been so in love with it and making it at home ever since. This is my take on a Thai curry broth, using red curry paste, poured hot over rice with these fall apart tender short ribs. The best part is the pressure cooker because it definitely saves you time (although I have instructions for alternate methods on my blog if you want!) link is in my bio.  It’s cozy, it’s comforting, warming and exactly what I want in a bowl right now :) https://britacooks.com/short-rib-coconut-curry-brothy-rice-bowls/ #soupsthatdontsuck #soupseason #souptok #comfortfood

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood
zh: 菲律宾猪肉阿斗波 | 菲律宾美食圣经 – 第1集 我对最具代表性的菲律宾菜之一——猪肉阿斗波的诠释！这个系列将展示所有菲律宾菜式及其变种。把它当作你的菲律宾美食指南。评论告诉我下次想看什么！ 食材： 猪肉阿斗波 - 1.2公斤五花肉（或自选部位） - 15-20瓣大蒜，切碎（可依口味调整，越多越好） - 1个洋葱，切碎 - 500毫升猪肉高汤 - 190毫升酱油 - 100毫升甘蔗醋 - 3根长绿辣椒 - 4片月桂叶 - 1汤匙整粒黑胡椒 - 30克椰糖，切碎（可依甜度调整） - 食用油，用于煎炸 配料 - 切片青蒜 - 酥脆蒜粒 - 水煮蛋 步骤 - 将猪肉煎至各面微黄，取出备用。 - 在同一锅中，将大蒜炒至微金黄且散发香味。加入洋葱，炒至变软。 - 将猪肉放回锅中，倒入猪肉高汤。加入酱油、醋、绿辣椒、月桂叶、黑胡椒和椰糖。 - 盖上锅盖，中火炖煮5-10分钟。**请勿搅拌，以便醋充分烹煮。 - 转小火慢炖1-2小时，直至猪肉软烂、酱汁收浓。最终状态应像油封一样，猪肉几乎浸在自身的油脂中。 - 可选步骤：如果搭配鸡蛋，在上桌前2-3分钟加入溏心蛋，以保持流心状态。 - 配上热米饭，顶部撒上酥脆蒜粒和青蒜，旁边放上水煮蛋。享用吧。

d: Filipino Hotcakes Ingredients: - 100g all-purpose flour made from U.S. wheat - 20g sugar - 5g baking powder - 1 egg - 60ml milk - 60ml water - 15g melted margarine - 2 drop yellow food coloring Topping: - Sugar & margarine Method: 1. In a large bowl, combine egg, sugar, milk, water, yellow food coloring, and margarine. Mix well. 2. Then add dry ingredients and mix until well combined. 3. Let the batter rest for 10 minutes. 4. Scoop the batter onto a heated pan. 5. Cook until bubbles appear on the surface. 6. Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes. 7. Serve with margarine and sugar. zh: 菲律宾热蛋糕 食材： - 100克美国小麦制成的中筋面粉 - 20克糖 - 5克泡打粉 - 1个鸡蛋 - 60毫升牛奶 - 60毫升水 - 15克融化人造黄油 - 2滴黄色食用色素 顶部配料： - 糖和人造黄油 步骤： 1. 在一个大碗中，混合鸡蛋、糖、牛奶、水、黄色食用色素和人造黄油。搅拌均匀。 2. 然后加入干性材料，搅拌至完全混合。 3. 让面糊静置10分钟。 4. 将面糊舀到预热的平底锅上。 5. 煎至表面出现气泡。 6. 翻面再煎1-2分钟。 7. 搭配人造黄油和糖一起享用。 关注我们，获取更多美味的面粉甜点食谱！ 转发这个视频给你的朋友，分享你的烘焙伙伴！

🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

🇵🇭 Chicken Pyanggang | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 14 Link in bio for my mom’s restaurant! 💜 Pyanggang is easily one of my favorite and most iconic Tausug dishes. Its “blackness” comes from charred coconut, giving you this rich, spicy, smoky coconut flavor unlike anything else! *Disclaimer: The term bible in the title is not used in a religious context, it’s to denote a collection of recipes :)  INGREDIENTS: Siyunog Lahing: - 2 mature coconuts, sun dried/roasted    Pamapa Itum: - 240-250g of siyunog lahing - 150g red onions - 1 head of garlic - 2 tbsp ginger - 2 tbsp turmeric  - 3-4 stalks of lemongrass, sliced - Red chili, to taste - 2 tsp of salt - 2 tsp black pepper Stewing Liquid: - Marinated chicken quarters - 2 red onions - 10-15 cloves of garlic - 1 tbsp of ginger, chopped - 3-4 stalks of lemongrass - red chili, to taste - 2 tbsp pamapa itum - 4 cans coconut milk - 2 tbsp fish sauce (optional) Sulu Style Sambal: - 3 tbsp of oil - 1 red onion - 1 head of garlic - 2 inches of ginger, minced - red chili to taste - 2 tbsp shrimp paste/alamang  - ½ kg tomatoes, chopped - 400 ml of coconut milk - 1 tbsp sugar - Pepper tp taste Turmeric Rice: - 3 cups washed rice - 3 ¼ cup water - 2 tsp turmeric powder - ¼ cup coconut milk INSTRUCTIONS: - Roast the dried coconut until charred w/ little brown in the center, grind in blender/mortar. - Make pamapa itum by mixing siyunog lahing w/ aromatics. Coat chicken lightly and marinate overnight. - For the pyanggang, sauté the aromatics under “pamapa itum” add coconut milk, add chicken and simmer on low for 30-40mins until cooked - Remove chicken and reserve liquid for basting. Add fish sauce and reduce. Grill the chicken, basting as you go, until nicely charred. - For the sambal, sauté all ingredients under “sulu style sambal”.  pour in the coconut milk. Season w/ pepper and sugar, and continue cooking until oils begin to separate. - Cook the turmeric rice with the water, turmeric, and coconut milk. - Serve everything together and enjoy! #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #tausug

d: Cajun butter steak bites over parmesan mashed potatoes🥩🧈 recipe below: Cajun butter🧈 -4 tbsp unsalted softened butter  -1/2 tsp seasoned Cajun -1 tsp parsley -2 tsp minced garlic  -1 tsp lemon juice -1/2 tsp Dijon mustard  Mix until combined (optional: add red pepper flakes for spice) Cajun steak bites🥩 -trim 2 steaks of choice into 1 inch pieces -season with 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 1 tsp buttery steakhouse seasoning -let steaks rest before cooking to avoid chewy steak bites ** -cook in avocado oil on med/high heat -flip after 1-2 minutes  -reduce heat and stir in 2 tbsp Cajun butter -toss steak bites 1 additional minute  -remove steak and add asparagus  -season asparagus with lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, pepper, & Parmesan  creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes🥔 -peel 2 large gold potatoes  -dice into 1 inch cubes  -boil in salted water -drain water and mash -stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sour cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/2 tbsp butter, salt, pepper, & garlic powder  Assembly✨ -Add creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes to a bowl and top with Cajun butter steak bites🥩 Serve with asparagus, ciabatta, & garnish with parsley  #cooking #foodtiktok #fyp  #creatorsearchinsights #whatdoimakefordinner

d: Garlic parmesan cheeseburger bombs 🍔  For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store! Save this recipe and thank me later 😌 RECIPE ⬇️ * 1 lb 80/20 ground beef * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  * 2 tsp Worcestershire  * Minced garlic  * Salt & pepper to taste  * Optional add-ins: caramelized onions, bacon * Mild cheddar, large cubes * Shredded mozzarella  * 1 can biscuit dough (Pillsbury original flakey layers, red top) * 1 egg, whisked (for egg wash) * Parmesan  Garlic butter: * 3 tbs salted butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, finely minced * Dried or fresh parsley 1. Cook the ground beef on medium heat. Once browned, add minced garlic and all the seasonings. Stir for a minute. Set aside.  2. Preheat oven to 375F 3. Take each biscuit and stretch it into a 5 inch circle. Add 2 spoonfuls of seasoned beef, some mozzarella, and a cube of cheese in the middle.  4. Fold the dough around the filling and pinch the edges tightly to seal. Pull it into a tight ball. Rest 5 min. 5. Place them seam side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush a thin layer of egg wash and sprinkle fresh grated parmesan. 6. Bake at 375F for 15-18 min until deeply golden. 7. Brush on garlic butter and sprinkle more parmesan. Serve immediately. #cheeseburgers #garlicparmesan #garlicknots #dinneridea #cheapmeals

Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi 🍝 Creamy, cozy, and irresistibly delicious gnocchi with tender chicken, sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, and Parmesan😍 All you need is:  •Chicken breast •Gnocchi •Onion •Garlic •Sun-dried tomatoes •Tomato paste •Chicken broth •Heavy cream •Fresh spinach •Parmesan •Olive oil or butter •Salt •Black pepper •Smoked paprika •Dried garlic •Oregano How To Make: 1. Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, dried garlic, and oregano. Fry in oil or butter on both sides until golden. Remove, cut into bite-sized pieces, and set aside. 2. In the same pan, sauté finely chopped onion, garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes. Add tomato paste, mix, and cook for about 5 minutes. 3. Pour in the chicken broth. Add the chicken pieces, spinach, and heavy cream. 4. Add the gnocchi and simmer until the gnocchi are tender and the sauce is creamy. 5. Finish with grated Parmesan and serve hot. #marrymechicken #gnocchi #cozydinner #dinnerideas #easydinnerrecipes

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

d: Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Fall Gameday Comfort Food Series Part 1: Honey Chipotle Fried Chicken Mac & Cheese Recipe👇: Ingredients • Chicken breast • Hot sauce • Pickle juice • Buttermilk • PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning • Potato starch • Flour • Frying oil • Honey chipotle sauce • Butter • Evaporated milk • Whole milk • Heavy cream • Mustard • Cheddar • Gruyère • Mozzarella • Oaxaca • Monterey Jack • Pasta shells • Paprika • Ranch • Parsley Instructions 1. Marinate the chicken in hot sauce, pickle juice, buttermilk and PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning. 2. Mix 2 parts potato starch with 1 part flour and more Cajun seasoning. Coat the chicken and fry until crispy and cooked through. Toss in honey chipotle sauce. 3. Melt butter, stir in flour and Cajun seasoning, then gradually add evaporated milk, whole milk and heavy cream. Once thickened, stir in hot sauce and mustard. 4. Melt in cheddar, Gruyère, mozzarella, Oaxaca and Monterey Jack. Fold in the cooked shells. 5. Add half the mac and cheese to a baking dish, layer with cheese, then add the rest. Top with cheddar and paprika and bake at 325°F until hot and bubbly. 6. Serve the mac and cheese topped with honey chipotle chicken, ranch and parsley. #chicken #cheese #chipotle #dinner #recipe

d: crispy chicken caesar salad croissants 🥗🥐 these over the wraps anyday omg 😣     recipe:   ingredients- 4 thin sliced chicken breasts 1 cup all-purpose flour (120g) seasonings (to taste)- salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for frying garlic butter- 2 tbsp melted butter (28g) 1 clove garlic, minced parsley extra parmesan caesar dressing- 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire sauce ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed) instructions: season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko mixture. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes. fry in oil over medium heat until golden brown and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. transfer to a wire rack. for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water until smooth and pourable. toss the chopped romaine with some of the caesar dressing. add croutons and extra parmesan. slice the croissants in half and spread a little caesar dressing on both sides. add the crispy chicken, top with the caesar salad mixture, and sprinkle with more parmesan. mix together the melted butter, garlic, and parsley. brush the tops of the croissants with the garlic butter and finish with extra parmesan. serve immediately and enjoyyyy    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #croissant #Recipe #EasyRecipe

d: My first cooking video. Not perfect in the slightest but I’ll get better with time! Dinner is served! Enjoy 😊 Here’s the recipe: BBQ Rub Seasoning 1/2 cup brown sugar 2 tablespoons paprika 1 tablespoon smoked paprika 1 tablespoon black pepper 1 tablespoon kosher salt 1 tablespoon garlic powder 1 tablespoon onion powder 1 teaspoon mustard powder 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper Pan Seared BBQ Skirt Steak Serves 2 1 pound skirt steak (2-3 pieces) 1 tablespoons olive oil  1 medium red onion 4 cloves garlic  Pinch of salt Black pepper to taste Creamy Garlic Mashed Potatoes Serves 2 2 large russet potatoes 3 medium to large gold potatoes 1/2 cup heavy cream (add slightly more if too thick) 4 tablespoons of butter 8 peeled whole cloves garlic Salt to taste Scallion for garnish (optional) Directions  Add all your seasoning into a bowl and mix until well incorporated.  Season your skirt steak. Rub olive oil onto the steak first until completely covered. Then add some of your BBQ rub seasoning until it’s well seasoned. There will be leftover rub which you can save for another dish. Let skirt steak rest until ready to cook. Cut your fresh ingredients. Mince 4 cloves garlic, slice your scallions, and slice whole red onion. Peel your potatoes (Does not have to be completely peeled if you like more texture on your potatoes)  Cut each potato into four pieces so they cook faster and more evenly. Put potatoes and 8 cloves whole peeled garlic into a pot and add cold water until potatoes are covered by 1 inch.  Cook on high heat and once the water starts to boil reduce to medium heat and cook for at least 12 minutes(can be up to 20 mins depending on how large potatoes are). Cook until the potatoes are fork tender. In another pan, add a little olive oil onto high heat. Let pan get hot(not too hot to avoid burning). Add your red onions and minced garlic. Cook for 1-2 minutes then transfer to a plate.  On that same high heat pan add seasoned skirt steak. Cook on very high heat for 1-2 minutes until well seared. Transfer to serving plate.   Reduce heat to medium high on the same pan add your cooked red onion and minced garlic back to pan with steak drippings and cook for another minute. Add on top of skirt steak. Drain the potatoes and garlic return to the pot. Begin to mash the potatoes and garlic with a potato masher. When they are partially mashed, add the butter, cream, and salt. Continue mashing until the potatoes reach your desired consistency (I like mine kinda chunky and thick)  Top your garlic mashed potatoes with scallions. #cooking #steak #fyp #dinner #cookwithme

d: Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

d: Recipe Name Smash Burger Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb ground beef 2. 6 small flour tortillas 3. 6 slices cheddar cheese 4. 2 cups shredded lettuce 5. 1/2 cup diced onion 6. 1/2 cup diced tomatoes 7. 1 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1 tsp smoked paprika 12. 1/2 cup mayonnaise 13. 2 tbsp ketchup 14. 1 tbsp yellow mustard 15. 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles 16. 1 tsp pickle juice 17. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 18. 1/4 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, and black pepper. 2. Stir the sauce until smooth, then refrigerate while preparing the tacos. 3. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor. d: 😋🤤save this recipe  Garlic Butter Steak with Parmesan Cream Sauce A rich, buttery steak dinner with a creamy garlic-Parmesan sauce. perfect for when you want something that feels like a steakhouse meal right at home. Ingredients: For the steak: 2 pounds steak, such as ribeye, sirloin, or strip steak 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon black pepper 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 3 tablespoons butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley For the Parmesan cream sauce: 2 tablespoons butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup heavy cream 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning 1/4 teaspoon black pepper Pinch of salt, to taste 1 tablespoon chopped chives or parsley Instructions: Pat the steaks dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Let them rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Heat a large cast-iron skillet or heavy pan over medium-hiah heat for 2-3 minutes. Add olive oil and and swirl to coat the pan. Place the steaks in the hot skillet and sear for 3-5 minutes per side, depending on thickness and desired doneness. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter and minced garlic to the pan. Spoon the melted garlic butter over the steaks for 1-2 minutes. Transfer the steaks to a plate and loosely cover with foil. Let them rest for 5-10 minutes while you make the sauce. In the same skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Pour in the heavy cream and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Simmer gently for 3-4 minutes. Stir in Parmesan cheese, Dijon mustard, Italian seasoning, black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until smooth and slightly thickened. Slice the steak against the grain, then spoon the Parmesan cream sauce over the top. Sprinkle with parsley or chives and serve warm with roasted potatoes, green beans. Prep Time: 25 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 45 minutes Servings: 4 | Calories: Approximately 690 per serving#fyp #viral #foodtiktok

d: For 8 yuan ($1 USD) in China, I got a full kilogram of Jiang Xiang Bing  (酱香饼). The dough is flattened so wide that it folds onto itself while  baking, creating layers of texture. After five minutes in the oven, a  sweet fermented wheat sauce is brushed over the top. The folds soak up  the sauce, locking in extra flavor. Sesame seeds and scallions are  sprinkled as the finishing touch. The result is a fluffy, chewy bread  with a perfect balance of sweet and savory.   #China #Food #Travel #ChineseFood #ChinaFood #StreetFood
zh: 在中国花8元（1美元）买了整整一公斤酱香饼。面团擀得很宽，烤制时折叠起来，形成层次感。烤五分钟后，刷上甜面酱。褶皱吸收酱汁，锁住更多风味，最后撒上芝麻和葱花。成品是松软有嚼劲的面饼，咸甜平衡。

d: Would you actually eat this street food? 😳 In this wild street food compilation, we explore some of the most unbelievable street food scenes from around the world. From massive woks full of noodles to busy street vendors cooking huge portions right in front of customers, this video shows the reality of street food markets and street food cooking that millions of people enjoy every day. Street food is famous for its bold flavors, fast cooking, and incredible variety. In many countries, street vendors prepare delicious meals in giant pans, sizzling grills, and steaming pots right on the street. But sometimes the cooking conditions can look a little questionable… which raises the big question — would you actually eat this street food? 🍜🔥 This street food video shows everything from huge noodle stir-fries and sizzling wok cooking to intense street kitchen action where vendors prepare food quickly for long lines of hungry customers. Street food markets are full of energy, heat, flames, and nonstop cooking that makes these food scenes fascinating to watch. Whether you love street food, enjoy food documentaries, or just want to see some unbelievable cooking moments, this street food compilation will definitely make you think twice. Some of these street food scenes look delicious… while others might make you wonder if you would really try it! 🤯 Let us know in the comments — would YOU eat this street food? 👇  #streetfood​ #shorts​ #food​

d: Don’t leave Rome without trying these 5 street foods 🇮🇹🍝 Save for your trip 📌  Rome has some of the best street food in Italy – from crispy supplì and pizza al taglio to proper Roman sandwiches and fresh maritozzi. 📌 Add these to your list 👇 1️⃣ Supplì (Trastevere) 🧀 Fried rice balls with tomato & mozzarella  📍 Via di S. Francesco a Ripa, 137  2️⃣ Trapizzino (Testaccio) 🔥 Roman stuffed pizza pockets 📍 Via Giovanni Branca, 88 3️⃣ Casa Manco   🍕 Pizza al taglio – pizza by the slice & priced by weight.  📍In @mercatoditestaccio – Via Aldo Manuzio, 66C 4️⃣ Mordi e Vai   🥪 Panino Romanesco – one of the best sandwich spots many people miss in Rome 🔥  📍 Also in Testaccio Market – Nuovo Mercato Comunale di Testaccio BOX 15 5️⃣ Regoli  🥯 Maritozzi – brioche filled with fresh whipped cream 📍 Via dello Statuto, 60 (10min walk from Termini station) If you’re planning a Rome food trip, these are all worth adding to your list – especially if you want a mix of local Roman food, classic street food, and traditional spots locals actually eat at. 💡 Travel Tip – ad Use the @tripspire.app before your trip to help organise food spots you save from social media posts. d: Some people say this city is the street food capital of Europe, so we spent two weeks eating our way through the city to see if it was true… 🌯 📍 Istanbul, Türkiye 🇹🇷  These were 4 street foods you can’t miss (Part 1): 1️⃣ Cheese Köfte Sandwich (Kuymaklı Köfte) 🧀 💰 400 TRY (£6.30 / $8.40) 📍 Tekrartekrarr Bay Köfte @tekrartekrarr  Emirhan Cad. Bestekar Sok. No:4/B, Dikilitaş, Beşiktaş Rich, cheesy and incredibly indulgent. The grilled köfte is cooked together with a Black Sea-style cheese mixture before being packed into fresh bread. 2️⃣ Beef Tantuni 🥩 💰 310 TRY (£4.90 / $6.50) 📍 Suat Usta Mersin Tantuni @suatustatantuni  Katip Mustafa Çelebi, Tel Sk. No:1, 34433 Beyoğlu Finely chopped beef cooked on a hot griddle with spices before being wrapped in thin lavash with tomatoes, onions and herbs. Juicy, flavourful and so well balanced it doesn’t need any sauce. 3️⃣ Adana Dürüm 🌯 💰 340 TRY (£5.40 / $7.20) 📍 Dürümcü Raif Usta @durumcuraifusta1  Molla Fenari, Vezirhan Cd. 65/a, 34120 Fatih Seasoned minced lamb is hand-shaped onto a long skewer, grilled over charcoal and wrapped in thin lavash. Smoky, juicy and packed with flavour. We also tried the Tavuk Şiş Dürüm, which actually ended up being my personal favourite. 4️⃣ İçli Köfte 🥟 💰 100 TRY each (£1.60 / $2.00) 📍 Sabırtaşı Restoran @sabirtasirestoran  Asmalı Mescit, İstiklal Cd. No: 112, 34430 Beyoğlu A crisp bulgur shell stuffed with seasoned minced meat, onions and spices. Crunchy on the outside, rich and savoury in the middle. 📌 Save this for your Istanbul trip and follow for Part 2 coming next. #istanbulfood #istanbulstreetfood #turkıshfood #streetfood #türkiye

d: Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak

d: Taco Loaded Potato Bowl 🌮🥔🔥 Doesn't get much better than this... easy, healthy and PACKED with flavor! Perfect quick simple delicious post workout meal, lunch or dinner! Great for meal prepping as well!  FULL RECIPE ⬇️ INGREDIENTS ~1.5 lbs Yukon gold potatoes  - 1 lb lean ground beef (Used 93/7)  - Extra virgin olive oil  - Taco Seasoning of choice  (I used @Grillin With Dad's)  Pico De Gallo (Combine all ingredients)  - 1 cup fresh diced tomatoes - 1/2 cup diced red onion  - 1 small jalapeño diced - (Remove seeds unless you want it spicy) - 1/2 cup chopped cilantro  - Juice of 1/2 a lime  - Salt to taste   Guacamole (Combine all ingredients)  - 2 medium sized avocados  - 1/2 cup diced red onion  - Juice of a lime  - 1/2 cup cilantro chopped  - Garlic powder to taste  - Salt to taste  Note: The measurements are estimated. Adjust ingredients to your liking.  Addition toppings: - Shredded Cheese - Sourcream - Cilantro  DIRECTIONS  1.  Prepare the Pico and guacamole then set in fridge.  2. Wash & dry the potatoes then dice them up into small cubes. Put them in a large bowl then add in olive oil and taco seasoning. Mix till well combined then place evenely on a lined baking sheet. Bake at 425 for ~30-35 minutes. Give a quick mix half way. 3. While the potatoes are in the oven, prep your ground beef. Add the ground beef to a greased large skillet over medium-high heat. Break it up then add in taco seasoning. Mix and add more if needed. I also like to add a bit of water or broth for extra moisture. Cook for 8-10 minutes mixing frequently until done to your liking.  4. Remove potatoes from oven and let cool for a few minutes.   5. Assemble your bowl & ENJOY! 🙌🏻 • • • • #explore #cooking #bhfyp #food #easyrecipe #simple #foodporn #healthy #tasty #healthyrecipes #calwillcookit #diet #healthylifestyle #mealprep #gains #weightloss #tacos #fitfood #highprotein

d: Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

d: This one is a super easy dinner recipe the whole family enjoys! Using rotisserie chicken makes this recipe even easier.  I’ll be posting easy dinners every day for the month of August! Make sure to let me know what meals would be helpful to your family.  Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Bake INGREDIENTS  1 lb of Cellentani Pasta  1 lb cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken) 15 oz jar of Alfredo Sauce 1 Ranch seasoning packet  1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 6 pieces of cooked and crumbled bacon Parsley INSTRUCTIONS  Cook at least 6 pieces of bacon and chop into small pieces. Boil one pound of pasta according to the directions on the package. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Pour the cooked pasta into the bottom of the baking dish. Add about 1 lb of rotisserie chicken, one jar of Alfredo sauce, and a ranch seasoning packet. Add some of the mozzarella, cheddar cheese, and some of the bacon and stir everything together well.  Top with a little bit more cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, and crumbled bacon. Bake at 375 degrees F for about 15-20 minutes. Serve and enjoy! #easyrecipes #easydinners #chicken

d: Pot Roast Dinner 🥘 • • Ingredients: • 2.5 lb beef chuck roast • 4 carrots • 4 celery stalks • 1 yellow onion • 1 lb mini golden potatoes • 4 garlic cloves, minced • Salt, generous amount • Black pepper, generous amount • Garlic powder, generous amount • Smoked paprika, generous amount • Olive oil, for searing • 2 tbsp tomato paste • 1 tbsp beef bouillon base • 1½ cups dry red wine (I used Cabernet Sauvignon) • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 4¼ cups beef broth • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp all-purpose seasoning • 1 tsp blackened seasoning • 1 tsp smoked paprika • 1 pack beefy onion soup mix • 4 sprigs rosemary • 2 bay leaves • ¼ cup unsalted real butter Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. 2. Pat the chuck roast dry and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 3. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chuck roast on all sides until deeply browned, then remove and set aside. 4. Add the carrots, celery, and yellow onion to the same pot. Sauté for a few minutes, scraping the bottom of the pot to deglaze, add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 5. Add the tomato paste and beef bouillon base, stirring everything together. Pour in the wine and let it reduce by about 50%. 6. Add the flour and stir until well combined and thickened. Add the chuck roast back into the pot, then pour in the beef broth. 7. Add the onion powder, garlic powder, all-purpose seasoning, blackened seasoning, smoked paprika, beefy onion soup mix, rosemary, bay leaves, and butter. 8. Cover with the lid and bake at 350°F for 2 hours. After 2 hours, add the mini golden potatoes. Cover and return to the oven for 1 more hour. 9. After 3 hours, check that the roast is fork-tender and the potatoes are cooked through. 10. d: Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. I hope you enjoy this simple and delicious recipe and follow for more! #fyp #BakeWithMe #sweettooth #cinnamonroll #viralvideo

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

d: Recipe Name French Onion Meatloaf with Melted Mozzarella Ingredients 1. 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef 2. 1 cup breadcrumbs 3. 2 large eggs 4. 1 small onion, finely diced 5. 2 large onions, thinly sliced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 1/3 cup milk 8. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 2 tbsp ketchup 10. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 11. 1 tsp salt 12. 1 tsp black pepper 13. 1 tsp garlic powder 14. 1 tsp dried thyme 15. 2 tbsp butter 16. 1 tbsp olive oil 17. 1 cup beef broth 18. 1 tbsp all-purpose flour 19. 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 20. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a loaf pan or baking dish. 2. Heat the butter and olive oil in a skillet. Add the sliced onions and cook over medium-low heat for 20–25 minutes until deeply caramelized. 3. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle in the flour, then add the beef broth and simmer until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat. 4. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, diced onion, milk, Worcestershire sauce, ketchup, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and thyme. 5. Mix gently until just combined, then shape into a loaf and place in the prepared pan. 6. Bake for 40 minutes. 7. Remove the meatloaf from the oven and spoon the caramelized onion mixture evenly over the top. 8. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese generously over the onions. 9. Return the meatloaf to the oven and bake for another 15–20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and lightly golden. 10. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 11. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley for extra flavor and color. 12. Serve hot with creamy mashed potatoes and your favorite vegetables. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

d: Recipe Name: Slow Cooker Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 4 bone-in pork chops 2. 1 tsp salt 3. 1/2 tsp black pepper 4. 1 tsp garlic powder 5. 1 tsp onion powder 6. 1 tbsp olive oil 7. 3 tbsp butter 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup chicken broth 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 13. 1/2 tsp paprika 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp water 16. 2 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown. 5. Transfer the pork chops to a slow cooker. 6. In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up any browned bits from the pan. 8. Stir in the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, and Italian seasoning. 9. Pour the creamy mixture over the pork chops in the slow cooker. 10. Cover and cook on LOW for 5–6 hours or HIGH for 2½–3 hours. 11. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl until smooth. 12. Stir the slurry into the slow cooker during the last 20 minutes of cooking. 13. Let the sauce thicken while the pork chops finish cooking. 14. Spoon the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce over the pork chops. 15. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. 16. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, or roasted vegetables.
